info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Underwriting Details API
info.description: The Underwriting Details API provides comprehensive access to underwriting records based on unique underwriting IDs. Users can retrieve detailed information regarding insurance applications, including risk assessments, coverage options, and individual client profiles. This API is essential for actuaries, risk analysts, and customer service representatives seeking to review or verify underwriting decisions. It facilitates transparency and efficiency in managing underwriting data within the financial services sector.

get.summary: Retrieve underwriting details for a specific sale.
get.description: Fetch comprehensive underwriting information related to the specified sale resource with ID RES-100045. This operation allows users to access crucial underwriting data, facilitating informed decision-making and efficient management of sale processes.
